verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair question for a payments and treasury product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack describes AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced from the user's data inside the product. The MCP server (stripe-crypto-docs-44) is a building block for external agents, and machine payments (stripe-crypto-docs-37) covers agents paying for services; neither is an in-product insights capability, so neither earns credit.
